A.summary: A registry of Command/Option records with an instance-owned redirect table, a parser that keeps character offsets, a suggester in a fixed order and a span-splicing fix renderer, all feeding one Refusal value that checks its own invariants. The kernels are methods on Shop behind a second, hand-kept handler table, and an executable docs.py holds one example per code.
forces_resolved: One place against many: every layer raises Failure and only Shop._refuse builds a Refusal, whose __post_init__ enforces the closed code, the ✗ tail and host_name only for E_HOST (impl-A/shopcli/engine.py:231-263, impl-A/shopcli/refusal.py:34-45)

Suggestion against misdirection: namespace, then redirect, then a budgeted guess. The budget counts only the verb segment, and `valid` is left empty when one answer is known (impl-A/shopcli/suggest.py:43-80, :97-112; impl-A/tests/test_refusals.py:129-133)
Generic against mined: the four task names are Redirects with concept hints, checked against the registry at load (impl-A/shopcli/registry.py:180-188, :324-343)
Precision against noise: a fix is the agent's line with only the failing token spliced in, so the repeat prefix and spacing survive (impl-A/shopcli/fix.py:17-32, impl-A/shopcli/parse.py:41-51)

Errors against warnings: a hard minimum refuses and a soft `usual` range warns; both live on the Option record (impl-A/shopcli/registry.py:29-30, impl-A/shopcli/engine.py:187-212); warnings are folded by (code, line, message) (impl-A/shopcli/warnings.py:26-33)
Host translation: E_HOST keeps type(exc).__name__, and a concept hint is looked up per host class from the registry (impl-A/shopcli/engine.py:216-227, impl-A/shopcli/registry.py:348-353)
forces_in_tension: Fixes are code: kernels get only `bound`, not the parsed line, so a kernel failure can never carry a fix. E_NOT_FOUND for a misspelled item lists `valid` but offers no fix even when one name is within budget (impl-A/shopcli/engine.py:96, :324-333)
Warning folding: the remove-overflow message embeds the current stock, so repeats of one line fold only partly (impl-A/shopcli/engine.py:285)

B.summary: A single commands.py holds the option tables, the handlers, a 125-line resolve() that does all name suggestion with difflib, and validate(). Diagnostic is the one exception type; a Frame renders full replacement lines, and _preview validates each candidate fix before it is offered.

Fixes are code and must bind: a candidate fix is re-parsed and validated before it is offered, and unknown keys are renamed or dropped (impl-B/shopcli/commands.py:350-397)
Warnings folded at the line: the warn closure keys on (line, code, message) (impl-B/shopcli/shop.py:52-67)
Deliver what came before: results from earlier repeat iterations survive (impl-B/tests/test_errors.py:79-85)
forces_in_tension: Host translation: host_name is filled with the canonical command name for every command-level error, and E_HOST also stores the command name rather than the exception class, which goes only into the message (impl-B/shopcli/diagnostics.py:63, impl-B/shopcli/shop.py:106); a test enshrines this (impl-B/tests/test_errors.py:64-70)
Suggestion against misdirection: E_ARG_RANGE for qty=-3 offers the fix qty=0, an invented value that runs and silently changes intent (impl-B/shopcli/commands.py:613-624)
Generic against mined: rm/delete/ls/inventory are silent aliases that execute, so the mined names never refuse or teach the real name (impl-B/shopcli/commands.py:49-54, :408-409)

C.summary: A catalog of Command/Option records with module-level aliases, a syntax module that collects structural Problems, and a 735-line engine that resolves names, validates, generates fixes and replays each fix against a cloned store before offering it. Handlers receive a _Call facade for failing, warning and rendering replacements.
forces_resolved: Host translation: E_HOST keeps the exception class and adds a concept hint for zero-price margins (impl-C/shopcli/engine.py:695-713)
Fixes must run: _finalize replays each fix on a cloned store and drops it if the replay fails (impl-C/shopcli/engine.py:716-735)
Deliver what came before: the repeat path is prefixed and earlier results are kept (impl-C/shopcli/engine.py:226-230)
forces_in_tension: Suggestion against misdirection: fixes invent values. qty=abc becomes qty=0, a missing qty is filled with qty=0, and qty=-3 becomes qty=0 (impl-C/shopcli/engine.py:574, :681, :602). The replay check passes these because they run (impl-C/shopcli/engine.py:726-735)

Fixes in the agent's line: a refusal inside `repeat N:` returns a fix without the prefix, because the body is run and rendered alone (impl-C/shopcli/engine.py:226-228; probe: 'repeat 3: item.ad ...' gives fix 'item.add name=w qty=1')
Warn and fold: the stock-total warning embeds a running total, so `repeat 8: item.add qty=300` yields five unfolded warnings (impl-C/shopcli/commands.py:90-95)
A warning that is usually wrong is worse than none: `repeat 0` always warns (impl-C/shopcli/engine.py:210-216)
Generic against mined: the task names are silent aliases, and the hint text repeats them as a hard-coded string (impl-C/shopcli/catalog.py:130-135, impl-C/shopcli/engine.py:323-324, :358-359)
Suggest in one fixed order: three ad hoc difflib routines with different cutoffs (impl-C/shopcli/engine.py:270-313)
forces_unnoticed: E_NAMESPACE as a structural fact: an unknown bare word (`mv`) gets E_NAMESPACE (impl-C/shopcli/engine.py:268), while a bare known verb gets E_UNKNOWN_COMMAND
Executable code documentation: there are no per-code examples, and a code no example raises would go unnoticed

D.summary: A Registry of Command/Option/Redirect records, validated at construction, with a suggester in fixed order (namespace, redirect, budgeted spelling) and a span-tracking parser. Shop.render_change splices one token (name, key or value) into the agent's source and offers it only if _binds() accepts it; kernels raise CommandFailure and receive a Context that can build a value fix.
forces_resolved: Suggest in one fixed order: structural home, then redirect, then a guess budgeted per segment, each returning a Suggestion with a code and a change (impl-D/shopcli/suggest.py:134-178)

Suggestion against misdirection: a structural home must be unique, and a namespace must sit within its budget before it is rewritten (impl-D/shopcli/suggest.py:108-131); a suggestion is dropped when its fix would not bind, but the hint stays (impl-D/shopcli/shop.py:337-338, impl-D/tests/test_fixes.py:122-124)

Fixes in the agent's line: name, key or value is spliced at its recorded span, so the prefix, the other arguments and the spacing survive (impl-D/shopcli/shop.py:309-338, impl-D/shopcli/parsing.py:36-46)
Kernels can repair from state: Context.fix_value lets item.remove offer qty=<stock> through the same splice and bind check (impl-D/shopcli/commands.py:71-77, :146-156)
Code list documented once with executable examples (impl-D/shopcli/codes.py:32-92, impl-D/tests/test_catalogue.py:39-56)
Host translation keeps type(error).__name__ (impl-D/shopcli/shop.py:282-306)
forces_in_tension: Precision against noise: the path label invents a call syntax the agent never wrote, 'item.add(name=w, qty=abc)', and E_NOT_FOUND tails are bare values such as '✗ w' (impl-D/shopcli/parsing.py:67-76, impl-D/shopcli/commands.py:96)

generativity.notes: A, D and E share the chapter's participants nearly one for one (Refusal, Code list with examples, Suggester, Redirect table on the registry, Translator, Warning folder) and the same rule that a fix never invents a value. They differ in where the fix is built: A and E build it only in the binder, so kernels cannot repair, while D's Context lets kernels splice a value fix that is then bind-checked. B and C share another shape: aliases instead of refusals, difflib suggestions inside long resolve functions, and generous fixes checked at runtime that invent values (qty=0). C also loses the repeat prefix. Within A/D/E, A and E are close at the level of whole functions (distance, budget, docs examples); D differs in detail (plain Levenshtein, a one-token splice for names, keys and values, runtime _binds).

worse_is_better: D reaches A's repair quality with fewer parts. It has no separate docs.py, fix.py, warnings.py or errors.py modules, no host-hint table and no load-time assertion layer on the Refusal, and its one render_change+_binds replaces A's two splice helpers plus a test-only changed_span. A's extras (Registry.documented, docs.describe, WarningFolder.raised, __post_init__ invariants) mostly serve its tests, not the task. E carries more than either: option redirects, notes, Param.maximum/default and a string-keyed kernel table that no current need uses. B is smallest in modules but buys it with a 125-line resolve() and a wrong host_name, so it is simpler without being as good.
chapter_lessons: Say where a fix may come from: three implementations (A, D, E) read the chapter as 'never invent a value' and kept fixes out of kernels, while two (B, C) invented qty=0. The chapter should separate a value the agent wrote, a value derived from state (qty=<stock>, an existing name) and an invented value, and allow the second explicitly. The next change (a rename collision) needs a state-derived or multi-line fix, and A and E have no seam for one.

A fix that binds is not a correct fix: C replays fixes on a clone and still offers qty=0 for qty=abc (impl-C/shopcli/engine.py:574, :726-735). Note 11 should say that binding is necessary but not sufficient, and that a fix must keep the agent's intent: same prefix, same values, one changed token.

Mined names: refuse or execute? B and C execute rm/ls silently as aliases, and A, D and E refuse with a fix. The chapter assumes refusal; it should name the trade-off (one round trip saved against an agent that never learns the canonical name) and say when an alias with a warning is the right choice.

The cross-kind fourth suggestion step and the multi-step path are machinery for object languages. All three suggester implementations skipped the fourth step with the same justification. The flat language made the path degenerate, and the implementations padded it with 'script, line N' (B, C), invented call syntax (D) or the whole body (E). The chapter should say what path means when there is no chain, or allow it to be just [prefix, command, ✗ failing part].

Folding keys on the message breaks when the message embeds state that changes per iteration (impl-C/shopcli/commands.py:92, impl-A/shopcli/engine.py:285). The chapter should tell implementers to fold on code, line and a message template, or to keep varying numbers out of the folded message.

host_name needs a sharper definition: B filled it with the command name for every error (impl-B/shopcli/diagnostics.py:63). The chapter should state that host_name is the host exception class and is null for every other code.

Put limits on the record: D put hard ranges in kernels and E/A put them on Param/Option; only the record placement lets the binder, the docs and the warnings share them. Note 10's 'one table owned by the registry' should cover ranges and usual ranges too, not only redirects.
